description: How a stencil's artwork adapts when the element is resized.

values.name: Scale
values.description: Scales the whole artwork uniformly with the element.

values.name: NineSlice
values.description: Keeps the corners fixed and stretches the edges and centre, driven by the stencil's Slice definition.

values.name: Reflow
values.description: Re-runs layout so children reflow into the new size instead of being scaled.
